evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, run() still unconditionally maps a None result from drain() to {'status':'drained'} and exit 0. That collapses an automatic pass that did not start, such as a clone-fetch or tick-lock failure, into the same success shape as a completed drain. The adjacent recover_job branch already preserves deferred/paused/busy reasons, so the automatic branch should preserve the actual non-start status rather than claim drained. This is a routine minor status-reporting defect, not a new requirement or an owner decision.
